column1: US01 Choose a topic and start an interview session
column3:
As a student, I want to choose a topic and start an interview session, so that I can practise a specific area.

Acceptance criteria: Algorithms selectable; session created with ID and time

column1: US02 System asks a technical question
column3:
As a student, I want the system to ask me a technical question, so that I can practise answering.

Acceptance criteria: Question generated by a server-side API call, returned as valid JSON; key not exposed

column1: US03 Submit an answer and receive a score and comment
column3:
As a student, I want to submit a text answer and receive a score and short comment, so that I get feedback.

Acceptance criteria: Score 0–5 and comment shown; answer, score and prompt version stored

column1: US04 Session saved across reloads
column3:
As a student, I want my session saved, so that a page reload does not lose my progress.

Acceptance criteria: Session, questions and answers survive reload and server restart

column1: US05 Five-question interview with summary
column3:
As a student, I want a complete five-question interview with a summary, so that practice feels like a real interview.

Acceptance criteria: Exactly five non-repeating questions; summary with total score

column1: US06 Rubric scoring: correctness, completeness, clarity
column3:
As a student, I want each answer scored on correctness, completeness and clarity, so that I see why I lost points.

Acceptance criteria: Output validated against a JSON schema; invalid output retried once

column1: US07 Continue after provider error or timeout
column3:
As a student, I want the interview to continue after a provider error or timeout, so that I do not lose my work.

Acceptance criteria: 30 s timeout and one retry; 10 injected failures, no lost session

column1: US08 Personal account with private results
column3:
As a student, I want a personal account, so that my answers and results are private.

Acceptance criteria: Register and log in; one user cannot read another user's session

column1: US09 Answers treated as data, not instructions
column3:
As a maintainer, I want answers treated as data, not instructions, so that a student cannot manipulate the score.

Acceptance criteria: 10 adversarial answers do not change scoring rules or inflate scores

column1: US10 Final feedback report
column3:
As a student, I want a final feedback report with strengths and weak points, so that I know what to revise.

Acceptance criteria: Report lists at least 2 weak points, each with a study suggestion

column1: US11 Pre-graded answer set and evaluation script
column3:
As a reviewer, I want a pre-graded set of 30 answers and an evaluation script, so that scoring quality is measured.

Acceptance criteria: Script reports agreement within ±1, latency and cost per interview

column1: US12 Deployed build with setup guide
column3:
As a technician, I want a deployed build with a setup guide, so that a second member can run it.

Acceptance criteria: Second member deploys from the guide on a clean machine

column1: US13 List of past interviews
column3:
As a student, I want to see my past interviews, so that I can compare attempts.

Acceptance criteria: List with date, topic and total score

column1: E1 Networks and Databases topics
column3:
As a student, I want questions on networks and databases as well as algorithms, so that I can prepare for all my courses.

Acceptance criteria: Three topics, at least 15 reference-backed questions each; rubric per topic reviewed by a lecturer

column1: E2 Weak spots grouped by subtopic
column3:
As a student, I want my mistakes grouped by subtopic, so that I know exactly what to revise.

Acceptance criteria: Every question tagged; report ranks at least 3 subtopics with a study suggestion each

column1: E3 Difficulty levels and follow-up questions
column3:
As a student, I want difficulty levels and follow-up questions, so that the interview fits my level.

Acceptance criteria: Level chosen at start; follow-up generated after a partial answer

column1: E4 Score chart over time
column3:
As a student, I want a chart of my scores per topic over time, so that I can see improvement.

Acceptance criteria: Chart per topic from at least 3 sessions

column1: E5 90-answer test set and tuned prompts
column3:
As a reviewer, I want a 90-answer test set and tuned prompts, so that scoring stays reliable across topics.

Acceptance criteria: At least 80% within ±1; repeat-run agreement at least 90%

column1: E6 30-student pilot
column3:
As the Product Owner, I want 30 students to use the product for three weeks, so that we learn from real use.

Acceptance criteria: Consent notice; at least 30 participants; weekly survey

column1: E7 Usage limits, caching and cost alerts
column3:
As a maintainer, I want daily per-user limits, caching and usage alerts, so that cost stays inside the envelope.

Acceptance criteria: Limit enforced; alert at 70% of API budget; average cost at most USD 0.10 per interview

column1: E8 Data deletion and privacy notice
column3:
As a student, I want to delete my data and know what is sent to the provider, so that I stay in control.

Acceptance criteria: Deletion works; notice names the third-party processor

column1: E9 Fix top pilot issues
column3:
As a student, I want the confusing parts found in the pilot fixed, so that the tool is easier to use.

Acceptance criteria: Top 5 pilot issues fixed and retested

column1: E10 Evaluation report and handover
column3:
As the instructor, I want an evaluation report and handover package, so that I can judge the outcome.

Acceptance criteria: All target measures reported or marked not validated; handover package complete
